payout_quote: Binge Eating Disorder | 18-55 | Outpatient | Up to $1,300. Segal Trials is currently conducting an outpatient clinical research study evaluating the safety and efficacy of an investigational medication for patients with Binge Eating Disorder. Participants may qualify if they are: Between the ages of 18-55, Meets Binge Eating Disorder criteria, Recurrent episodes of Binge Eating. Study length: Up to 18 weeks. Participants who qualify may receive: Study-related exams & lab work - at no cost, Available transportation, No insurance is necessary, Compensation up to $1,300 for time and Travel.
steps: Open the Segal Trials study page for the Binge Eating Disorder study (18-55, outpatient).
Check the qualification criteria and complete the eligibility screener.
Pass screening (must meet Binge Eating Disorder criteria) and enroll.
Complete the outpatient visit schedule over the up-to-18-week study.
Receive compensation up to $1,300 for time and travel.
catches: Only adults 18-55 meeting Binge Eating Disorder criteria qualify — this is a patient study; not everyone qualifies.
The $1,300 is an 'up to' ceiling tied to completing the visit schedule over up to 18 weeks.
You receive an investigational medication with real medical risks disclosed in informed consent.
Segal Trials' inpatient studies pay far more (e.g., Acute Schizophrenia inpatient study up to $11,700) but require psychiatric inpatient stays.
Free transport to other study locations is offered, but travel time is your own.
The official listing does not state the exact visit schedule or visit count, so the total time above is an estimate — the actual time commitment could be higher.
You must pass the study screening process (medical history review, labs/exams as required) to enroll; not everyone qualifies.
biggest_catch: The $1,300 is a ceiling for completing an up-to-18-week outpatient study, and only people meeting Binge Eating Disorder criteria qualify — a patient study with an investigational medication, not a casual payout.
eligibility: Ages 18-55; must meet Binge Eating Disorder criteria; recurrent episodes of binge eating; no bariatric surgery; other screening criteria apply.
timing: Compensation paid for time and travel over the course of the study.
